metadata.description: Sereneco agent plugins, skills and hooks for review discipline, session continuity, security guardrails, permission-prompt reduction and human-readable writing.

plugins.name: adversarial-review
plugins.description: Adversarial code, architecture and specification review using OpenAI Codex as a second hostile reviewer, with PreToolUse hooks enforcing write-path authorisation, refutation-appendix ingestion and rubric integrity.

plugins.name: handoff
plugins.description: Write and resume HANDOFF.md so work survives context limits, /clear and session boundaries without the user re-explaining the task.

plugins.name: guard-hooks
plugins.description: Security guardrails as hooks: block dangerous shell commands, writes to credential files and system paths, and secrets in file content; refuse to read a file holding a live credential or to print a credential-bearing environment variable; pre-approve provably-safe rm; enforce the project's package manager; block PR merges whose checks failed or never ran and branch deletions that would discard someone else's work; warn on destructive git operations; alarm if a credential reaches the transcript anyway.

plugins.name: check-compound-bash
plugins.description: PreToolUse hook that splits compound Bash commands into their sub-commands with shfmt and checks each against your Bash(...) allow and deny rules: auto-approves when every segment is allowed, denies when any segment is denied, otherwise falls through to the native prompt.

plugins.name: humanize
plugins.description: One skill for anything a person will read. humanize classifies the text as a reply, documentation or creative copy and applies the matching ruleset (procedural-writing, descriptive-writing, creative-copy) so the reader gets it in one pass. A SessionStart hook loads the reply rules so answers in the conversation follow them too.
